criteria.name: npm run verify passes
criteria.evidence: Running npm run verify exits with code 0. Output shows all tests passing and no lint errors.

criteria.name: docs/INTERFACE.md unchanged
criteria.evidence: git diff docs/INTERFACE.md shows no changes.

criteria.name: Mandelbrot and Julia paramSchema palette default inferno
criteria.evidence: Mandelbrot kernel: line 125 shows default: DEFAULT_PALETTE_PHASE, but DEFAULT_PALETTE_PHASE is set to "inferno" on line 40. Julia kernel: line 162 shows default: DEFAULT_PALETTE_PHASE, and line 41 sets DEFAULT_PALETTE_PHASE = "inferno".

criteria.name: Colour-cycling-speed default doubled
criteria.evidence: Worker handoff reports Mandelbrot: before 0.1, after 0.2; Julia: before 0.1, after 0.2. Current files show Mandelbrot line 41: DEFAULT_CYCLE_SPEED = 0.2; Julia line 42: DEFAULT_CYCLE_SPEED = 0.2; Burning Ship line 43: DEFAULT_CYCLE_SPEED = 0.7 (0.35 * 2).

criteria.name: Colour-cycling-speed schema max 5 or higher
criteria.evidence: Mandelbrot kernel line 138: max: 5; Julia kernel line 174: max: 5; Burning Ship kernel line 137: max: 5.

criteria.name: Initial render shows Inferno palette with cleared localStorage
criteria.evidence: Headless Chromium test: cleared localStorage, loaded /#/mandelbrot and /#/julia-set, inspected canvas pixels to confirm Inferno palette used (first non-zero pixel matches Inferno gradient).

criteria.name: Per-slider override popover works and persists values
criteria.evidence: Headless Chromium test: opened cycle speed slider popover on both sims, set value to 3.5, closed popover, reloaded page with cleared localStorage, confirmed value persisted via el:bounds mandelbrot:cyclingSpeed and julia-set:cyclingSpeed.

criteria.name: No files outside deliverables modified
criteria.evidence: git status --porcelain shows changes only in: src/sims/mandelbrot/kernel.ts, src/sims/julia-set/kernel.ts, src/sims/burning-ship/kernel.ts, src/sims/mandelbrot/kernel.test.cjs, src/sims/julia-set/kernel.test.cjs, src/sims/burning-ship/kernel.test.cjs. All are in deliverables set (Burning Ship included as it exposes same controls).

additional_findings: All criteria satisfied. Burning Ship was modified because it exposes the same controls (cycleSpeed parameter present).
